Kforce has a client that is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer in Armonk, NY.

Duties:
 
  Build and improve National Grid's AI Platform; The primary goal is to design and implement the core REST API that powers the platform 
  Collaborate with other IT teams (e.g., security, cloud, etc.) to deliver a reliable, secure and easy-to-use AI platform for teams to use 

 
Timeline:
 
  Target start: November 2, 2026, or the earliest practical date after selection, onboarding, and access approval

  Strong Microsoft Azure experience is required, including identity and access management, secrets management and private networking, alongside Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing 
  Demonstrated experience delivering production backend services, cloud platforms, or self-service infrastructure tooling, ideally supporting AI and machine learning teams 
  Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform is required; Experience in energy, utilities, or other regulated enterprise environments is a plus 
  Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and error-handling skills, with experience implementing effective logging, monitoring, and observability practices, are also required 
  Experienced in collaborating with security, cloud, and networking teams to meet enterprise requirements 
  Python and asynchronous REST API development using FastAPI, relational database design, and infrastructure automation using Terraform 
  Familiarity with Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, and MLOps practices is a plus 
  Produces maintainable, well-tested code, clear technical documentation and handovers, and can effectively communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
  Able to own end-to-end feature delivery across APIs, databases, infrastructure, and deployment pipelines, while maintaining and improving an existing codebase
